description: REQ-BILL-011 states link session consumption occurs 'After all pre-payment validations pass, before PAY.JP writes begin', listing consumption BEFORE 'PAY.JP token verification, operationId persistence, PAY.JP writes'. However, implementation-design-mvp.md section 5.1 specifies step 7 as 'operationId preservation + inflight_operation_* setting' and step 8 as 'link session consumption'. The 2weeks-spec.md line 192 also states operationId is saved BEFORE link session consumption. The behavioral spec REQ ordering contradicts the source documents by placing consumption before operationId persistence.

evidence.snippet: Consumption occurs before: PAY.JP token verification, operationId persistence, PAY.JP writes

sourceReference.snippet:
7. operationId を保存し inflight_operation_*（type=subscribe）を設定する
8. 認証前提検証通過時点で __Host-link_session を消費する

remediation: Correct REQ-BILL-011 acceptance criteria to state: consumption occurs AFTER operationId persistence (step 7 in implementation-design) but BEFORE PAY.JP token verification (step 9). The sequence must be: pre-validations -> operationId persistence -> link session consumption -> PAY.JP token verification -> PAY.JP writes.
